Definition: from G2596 and accusative case plural feminine of G3441 (with G5561 implied); according to sole places, i.e. (adverbially) separately:--alone.
BiblicalUsage: When Jesus was alone, those around Him with the twelve asked Him about the parables, and again He was alone praying when the disciples joined Him and He asked who men said He was.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the alone times with Jesus are where the parables open and the real questions get asked.
